# Monthly Business Review

**First Tuesday · 90 minutes · Founders + leads + advisor**
Purpose: decide, not present. One gate decision or one course correction per month.

---

## 1. The P&L, honestly (20 min)

| | This month | Last month | Plan | Variance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Orders | | | | |
| GMV (P) | | | | |
| Product gross margin % | | | | |
| Delivery revenue (P) | | | | |
| **Contribution (P)** | | | | |
| Fixed costs (P) | | | | |
| **Operating profit (P)** | | | | |
| Cash at month end (P) | | | | |
| Cash buffer (weeks) | | | | |

**The question this section must answer:** are we profitable per order, and is the gap to
break-even closing or widening?

## 2. Route P&L (15 min)

| Route | Drops | Revenue | Cost/drop | Contribution | 1st-attempt % |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Route 1 | | | | | |
| Route 2 | | | | | |

## 3. Engine reviews (20 min)

Each owner gets 4 minutes. Number, cause, action. No narration of effort.

- **Demand** — orders, sessions, conversion, CAC by channel, repeat cohorts
- **Basket** — AOV, items/order, bundle attach, free-shipping threshold behaviour
- **Delivery** — cost/drop, density, first-attempt, reason-code Pareto
- **Money** — cash cycle, COD share, refund days, settlement lag
- **Trust** — NPS, disputes, review volume, published scorecard shipped?

## 4. Gate progress (15 min)

| Gate | Evidence required | Evidence held | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| G_ | | | pass / not yet / fail |

**A gate is passed on artifacts in the register, not on a verbal claim.**

## 5. Assumption register (10 min)

- Assumptions closed this month: ______
- Refuted: ______ → what decision changed?
- New assumptions added: ______

## 6. Risk (5 min)

- Any trigger fired? ______
- Any score moved up? ______
